investigation.title: Swarm Gateway 502 Blocks All Remote Agent Checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime)
investigation.summary: All three remote-agents feature checks (remote-agent-create, remote-agent-state, remote-agent-runtime) failed at 2026-09-02T12:37–12:38Z with an identical 502 bad_gateway error: the production API's POST /api/agents call could not reach the swarm gateway ELB at /v1/agents. Because the failure occurs before any agent is provisioned, no evidence (orgId, agentId, vmIdPresent, remoteState) was collected, and all contract assertions are unverifiable.
investigation.rootCause: The swarm gateway — the upstream dependency that the production API proxies to at the AWS ELB endpoint for /v1/agents — was unreachable at the time of the eval run. The production API returned HTTP 502 with code "bad_gateway" and the message "swarm gateway unreachable during agent provisioning" for every attempt across all three sibling checks, indicating the failure is in the swarm gateway layer (or the network path between the production API and the ELB), not in the eval runner or its configuration. This is an eval-detected infrastructure availability signal; no user-traffic or incident evidence is present in the packet to confirm a broader production outage.

investigations.rootCause: The swarm gateway — an AWS ELB in us-east-2 fronting the /v1/agents provisioning endpoint — was unreachable at the time of the eval run. Because agent creation failed immediately, no agent identity or runtime response was ever produced, so all five required evidence fields are missing and the message assertion ("hello from aura") could not be evaluated. investigations.summary: The eval for check published-observability-snapshot failed because the snapshot at https://cypher-asi.github.io/aura-os/observability/status.json was last generated 694 minutes ago, more than double the 300-minute maximum age asserted by the expected-output contract. All other public-website sibling checks passed, isolating the failure entirely to the staleness of the published JSON artifact rather than any broader site or infrastructure outage.
investigations.rootCause: The GitHub Actions workflow responsible for regenerating and publishing the observability snapshot at https://cypher-asi.github.io/aura-os/observability/status.json did not run successfully within the required 300-minute window. The snapshot on disk is structurally valid (schemaVersion=1, source=github-actions, hasLiveSource=true, 19 features, unknownFeatureCount=0) but its generatedAt timestamp is approximately 11.5 hours old at eval time, causing the snapshotAgeMinutes assertion (max: 300) to fail with an observed value of 694. This is an eval-layer signal of a missed or failed workflow run; no evidence of a user-facing site outage is present.
